name: io.github.BlancasJ/zapsign-mcp
title: ZapSign (unofficial)
description: ZapSign e-signature API: reads run freely, writes ask first, personal data filtered out.

packageArguments.description: The ZapSign environment: sandbox, or prod (read-only)
